stem.text: A car of total mass $1560\,\text{kg}$ is travelling with a constant speed of $32\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The driving force provided by the car is $680\,\text{N}$. The kinetic energy of the car is $800\,\text{kJ}$ and its momentum is $50\,000\,\text{N s}$.
Which two items of data could be used to calculate the useful power output of the car?
